SELECT pog.product_id,
    og.id AS option_group_id,
    oc.id AS option_choice_id,
    oc.label,
    oc.value,
    oc.price_delta,
    oc.sort_order
   FROM product_option_groups pog
     JOIN option_groups og ON og.id = pog.option_group_id
     JOIN option_choices oc ON oc.option_group_id = og.id
     JOIN products p ON p.id = pog.product_id
  WHERE p.is_published = true AND p.is_available = true AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND og.is_active = true AND pog.is_active = true AND oc.is_active = true;

SELECT pod.product_id,
    pod.option_group_id,
    pod.option_choice_id
   FROM product_option_defaults pod
     JOIN product_option_groups pog ON pog.product_id = pod.product_id AND pog.option_group_id = pod.option_group_id
     JOIN option_groups og ON og.id = pod.option_group_id
     JOIN option_choices oc ON oc.id = pod.option_choice_id AND oc.option_group_id = pod.option_group_id
     JOIN products p ON p.id = pod.product_id
  WHERE p.is_published = true AND p.is_available = true AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND og.is_active = true AND pog.is_active = true AND oc.is_active = true;

SELECT pog.product_id,
    og.id AS option_group_id,
    og.group_key,
    og.name,
    og.selection_type,
    pog.is_required,
    pog.min_selections,
    pog.max_selections,
    pog.sort_order
   FROM product_option_groups pog
     JOIN option_groups og ON og.id = pog.option_group_id
     JOIN products p ON p.id = pog.product_id
  WHERE p.is_published = true AND p.is_available = true AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND og.is_active = true AND pog.is_active = true;
